description: The Mullet Pro is Here! Assembled in America Our first US-Assembled bike is the Mullet Pro. With upgrades throughout to the top brands of all major components, the new Mullet Pro is Cyberbike's flagship. The 2021 Cyberbike Mullet Pro is an amazing value in a high performance eBike. 48 volt mid drive power, 13Ah battery for long rides, 130mm travel Sträva forks and rear shock. 12- speed 11-44 tooth rear cassette makes the Mullet Pro our best climbing bike yet. SRAM derailleur and shifter, 4 piston brakes and much more. 29/27.5 Maxxis Minion Tubeless Tires on WTB Wheels Bontrager Bars Sträva Euro Series long-travel, fully adjustable suspension, front and rear. 300mm bottom bracket ground clearance. Absolutely loaded with tech: Premium, name-brand components and 624 watt hours of mid-drive power. Top quality components, more travel, even more climbing capability and seamless pedal assist. T
